text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame's injury is serious.
I hurried and took her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... that things turned out this way...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...If only I had been more dependable...
choice_data_list: For now, let's just focus on resting quietly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still... is it really okay for me to rest...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because... the girls around me are all so amazing...
And even now, everyone is striving to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And yet... if this keeps up...
...Kh.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just rehab, I don't mind.
Won't you let me do... something?
choice_data_list: ...If I think it's dangerous, I'll stop it immediately.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Still...
choice_data_list: It's okay. We've come this far... little by little

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: An injury is just something to overcome one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being so demanding.
I'll stay quiet and rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm healed... I look forward
to training with you again!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, it really is a little...
choice_data_list: ...Shall we call off the rehab, too?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Understood...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Things really don't go
quite as planned, do they...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the pain has worsened.
Let's rest for now and focus on making a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Alright!
If it's just stretching, there's no pain at all.
choice_data_list: First, we can breathe a sigh of relief...
First, we can breathe a sigh of relief...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So... would it be all right
if we continued like this?
choice_data_list: If it gets too tough, tell me right away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Alright.
Even if it's little by little, I'll move forward...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame slowly but surely made her return to training.
